svg.title: 31 · FDC / WH_Channel/Logic
svg.text: ADDED · Source sequence exhaustion or invalid sequence latches fault 13.
ADDED · Calculate the next source sequence only within its bounded DINT range.
ADDED · A source sequence gap latches fault 13.
ADDED · Clear this invocation's capture request.
ADDED · Capture the source-mapped physical/operator event. Broadcast command bits alone are context, not 96 events.
ADDED · Remember this scan's command mask after evaluating the edge.
ADDED · An event arriving outside armed state 10 latches overrun fault 11; frozen evidence survives.
ADDED · Bound the event counter before any publication increment.
